t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are two types of basket to choose from, and if one starts high, then it usually will remain high. Once they drop it is advised to change. Multipliers are good at x5 but may get more mushrooms with x1 - need to assess

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes tend to remain high or low point earners for about 4-5 rounds and then change. If you have had luck with the gnome and scored about 30-40 points, when multiplied, this is a good score so keep choosing this gnome until the points stop, and then swap. The baskets I paid less attention to, and it was more the colour of the gnome so remember which is high points and which are low
